hooks.command:
set -- `# <#`
if command -v cloakroom >/dev/null 2>&1; then cloakroom hook start; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "cloakroom: NOT protecting this session, the cloakroom program is not installed or not on PATH. Tool calls are blocked until it is. Install it with: uv tool install cloakroom[model,torch] (then restart Claude Code), or turn the plugin off with /plugin disable cloakroom@cloakroom."}'; fi; exit 0
: <<'#PS_END'
#>
$u = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false; [Console]::InputEncoding = $u; [Console]::OutputEncoding = $u; $OutputEncoding = $u; if (Get-Command cloakroom -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | & cloakroom hook start } else { '{"systemMessage": "cloakroom: NOT protecting this session, the cloakroom program is not installed or not on PATH. Tool calls are blocked until it is. Install it with: uv tool install cloakroom[model,torch] (then restart Claude Code), or turn the plugin off with /plugin disable cloakroom@cloakroom."}' }; exit 0
#PS_END
